name: Elfern
summary: Two-player German no-trump trick-and-draw game where only high cards count and 11 of 20 points wins.
rules_text: 32-card Piquet/Skat pack ranks A>K>Q>J>10>9>8>7, no trumps. Deal 6 cards each in 2s, rest as stock. Forehand leads. Winner of trick takes it and draws top stock first, loser draws second, winner leads next. No need to follow suit while stock remains. After stock empty, play remaining hand cards out, must follow suit if possible, highest card of led suit wins trick. Cards 7-9 are blanks worth 0, A/K/Q/J/10 (or Deuce/King/Ober/Unter/Ten) each worth 1, 20 points total. Player with 11+ wins deal, 15+ wins double (schneider), 20 wins triple (schwarz). Tie at 10-10 scores as Ständer, carryover to next deal.
